description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GlobalConfigurationPropertyNotFoundException' used within the Fineract project to indicate when a specific global configuration property or ID is not found. It extends an abstract exception class and provides constructors for exception messages.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationPropertyNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a global configuration property or ID was not found.

methods.name: GlobalConfigurationPropertyNotFoundException(String propertyName)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a specific configuration property by name does not exist.

methods.name: GlobalConfigurationPropertyNotFoundException(Long configId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a specific configuration ID does not exist.

calls: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
